name: Forward Bloc
role: Anti-Colonial Political Party Associated with Subhas Chandra Bose
contribution: Forward Bloc represented Subhas Chandra Bose's attempt to consolidate a more radical anti-colonial current after his break with Congress leadership.
context: Late-colonial Bengal, Congress politics, wartime anti-colonial organizing, and Bose's political legacy.
impact: Its Bengal significance lies in linking Bose's mass appeal, left-nationalist politics, and debates over militant anti-colonial strategy.
highlight: Subhas Chandra Bose's party and a reference point for radical anti-colonial politics in Bengal.
seoTitle: Forward Bloc - Subhas Chandra Bose and Bengal Politics Profile
seoDescription: Profile of Forward Bloc and its place in Subhas Chandra Bose's anti-colonial politics and Bengal history.
shortAnswer: Forward Bloc was Subhas Chandra Bose's party, associated with radical anti-colonial politics in Bengal and India.

faq.question: Why include Forward Bloc in Bengal history?
faq.answer: It is tied to Subhas Chandra Bose's political trajectory and to radical anti-colonial currents with strong Bengal resonance.
